author: pm
body:
Sheet 010 (InterfaceNdButton) is now drawn only by screen_select_character.cpp, using frame 61 (the plain card) and frame 62 (the gold card on the focused slot). Frame 61 duplicates the card already baked into intermediate_screens 005. The user, 2026-11-25: "Keep 61/62 for now" (HH-0097).

**Done when:** frame 62 is recreated (or the focus look is replaced), 61 is dropped, sprite 10 is emptied to a placeholder, and 010.png is archived to working/archive/interface/game_dialogs/.

Source: HH-0097 close-out, 2026-11-25.

**Scope change, 2026-11-25:** frames 61/62 are no longer drawn (HH-0108 replaced them with the HD cards), and nothing draws from sheet 010 at all. User: "Yes, retire it" - retire the whole sheet.

**Closed, 2026-11-25:** sheet 010 retired in 35312d33. Archive sha256 5359a68e... matches HEAD; client builds and deploys clean; review passed with no findings.
